scope: Glycoproteins were enriched using Streptavidin, and on-bead digestion yielded solid phase-bound glycopeptides that were released with acid.

the alkyne-tagged glycoproteins were derivatized with azide-biotin using CuI-catalyzed [3+2] “click” cycloaddition and characterized on a streptavidin blot.
